reviews.text: Delicious

We went there on Saturday night to celebrate my birthday. We went directly from outdoor climbing, so we had a few climbing pads and a cake. The host was so friendly and helpful. He took care of everything. We had a good dinner. Food was standard, price was reasonable.

Beef had an aftertaste like chlorine bleach. I couldn’t eat it. Lamb was tough and had to be spit out into a napkin. You have to pay for the self service sauce station. First time I’ve ever felt sick from the amount of oil I consumed from the broth. They disguise the taste of the meat with how spicy they make everything, even the mild broth. I am really surprised by the high rating here. I don’t really have anything positive to say about this place.
My go to hot pot spot in manhattan. Fresh ingredients and really nice soup base 🙏
好吃！店铺很干净又不失烟火气

Very casual style hot pot place in Manhattan. We went for a team dinner and I wish they gave us two pot because it was eight of us, but besides that their meat quality is good and portion of vegetable is also very large.

We made a reservation and we still had to wait at least an extra 10-15 minutes when we arrived within our reservation time— they clearly didn’t have a proper table for us. They frequently showed up with duplicates of food that we didn’t order and we had to show on the screen that we only ordered one of a dish.

They had us sit at a small table meant for 4 (we had 5), then made us move to a bigger, proper table after settling into the first table, which was a move that didn’t make any sense. Either way, not coming back.
好吃😋
Had diarrhea the next day.

i don't normally go for hotpot as a meal, but visiting new york, my friend took me here and i was amazingly satisfied with the amount of food i ate. i never knew i'd be able to handle super spicy hotpot but it made everything taste so much better (with some numbing). i will definitely be coming back here

The food was great! So delicious and fresh and everything came quick and was presented beautifully. Truly the only issue was with the service, the waiter never smiled not even once and just had sort of an attitude the entire time. Weren’t asked how everything was or if we needed anything or just basic good customer service you’d expect. Despite that it still wasn’t the worst and he could have just had an off day so I would definitely come back!

We went on Wednesday for member day: 20% off + $0.99 specials! It was pretty crowded though, so expect a wait🥹

The fresh duck blood was SO tender and flavorful，we finished two plates!

Definitely recommend the mild spicy broth. Our must-orders: thick-cut marbled beef, beef tongue, black tripe, chicken feet, shrimp paste, and bamboo fungus. The thousand-layer tripe was only $0.99 on Wednesday too!

The sauce bar was great，loved the lychee, purple rice porridge, and especially their fragrant sesame oil dipping sauce.
Amazing! Tastes amazing and high quality
Great hot pot!

Really good hot pot! The broth was flavorful, and everything we ordered was fresh. The beef and tripe were especially good. Service was quick and friendly too. Definitely a good spot for hot pot in Manhattan!

Super clean setting, everything looks brand new. Great ordering experience with an iPad  and good broth. There are lots of spicy and non spicy options. Everything comes out fresh, and you can get ice cream to cool your mouth when it gets too spicy! Good for groups.

食物ok，但戴眼鏡的男服務生態度跩，也不介紹，跟服務員拿個湯匙問了三次都不回。

I was excited to check this place out after seeing it on google. Dined here with my partner in the afternoon. When we arrived and sat down the place wasn’t full, only two tables plus us. The waiter that sat us was pleasant enough when speaking to us, asked if we’ve had Hot Pot before and explained how it works as they do. Though when we ordered our food we had missing item (noodles/ramen we ordered). the waiter didn’t provide us with the correct bowls or utensils even though she clearly saw we didn’t have any because she had no issue staring from afar. we ended up using the bowls our ingredients and veggies came in since we assumed it was an accident and they just forget to provide their customers with the proper bowls at a soup restaurant, that’s okay! As I went up to the ingredient station another worker that was there had no issue showing her attitude rolling her eyes. luckily we didn’t have to deal with her too much. Waiter barely helped  us after ordering, she only came up to us to ask if we wanted desert in a tone that only indicated that she wanted us to start checking out despite being there for less than an hour. Atmosphere was nice and the restaurant was very clean which is great. Food was okay I wouldn’t say it’s worth the price and the service definitely didn’t help. I suppose we weren’t their “target” customers. Read the critical reviews and you’ll see this isn’t a new issues. Go if you enjoy authentic hot pot. Hopefully it was just a bad day for the servers.
Great service!
Service and food were amazing, the people are so nice!

Been here three times already and I love it! Service is quick and they regularly stop by to refill the broth and waters. Great place for a more antisocial dinner as you order everything on a tablet. It is a bit expensive but the meat is great quality and you truly get your moneys worth!
这家火锅味道地道，食材新鲜可口。重点夸一下服务员Kevin，待人热情风趣，做事麻利勤快。添汤、换餐具都很主动，全程服务贴心又周到，相处起来特别轻松愉快。美食配上优质服务，用餐体验满分，真心推荐大家前来打卡！

Food came very fast after sending order on the tablet. Water and broth was restocked accordingly. The sauce station was very clean. The side dishes were yummy. Highly recommend.

I know this isn't the staff's fault but they were severely understaffed when my friend and I came here for dinner. Not only do they nickel and dime everything including paying for the sauce bar, we got one plate of lamb almost an hour into being seated with nothing else on the table but the broth. Then the rest of the dishes came 20-30 minutes after that. It was very backed up and frustrating that there was no acknowledgment of the slow service and we honestly would've gone elsewhere had we known it would take 90 minutes to get our main order.

service was really attentive, i forgot a hairtie and they provided one! food was great, the spice levels are definitely on the spicier side so I would recommend going with the less spicy options. atmosphere was good, we enjoyed our time here!

We ordered the two broth option with the house mild spicy and tomato bases. Both were flavorful! The tomato broth had a nice, strong taste but the “mild spicy” ended up being a bit spicier than expected. There was also a good selection of meats and vegetables.

At the end of the meal, the staff mentioned that leaving a 5-star review would remove the $3 per person sauce bar charge. While optional, this felt a bit uncomfortable and dishonest and may help explain the restaurant’s very high rating.

Authentic Chinese Hot Pot
The service is great, the restaurant is clean, and I highly recommend it.
The regular red hot broth is pretty spicy, so you might want to go for the mild version?
Personally, I really liked the tofu skin and mushroom broth, so next time I think I'll try a pot packed with tofu skin and mushrooms

The handmade noodles looked delicious, too.

#hotpot #nyc #chinese
Very good food i liked the dessert. The waiters came in clutch when my mouth was burning of spice, refilling my water. Chill place tbr.
Great service and plenty of options to chose from. The pork broth is to die for! We went for the beef tongue and sliced beef and it did not disappoint.

I appreciated that they stored our coats away to prevent the smell from sticking and they also gave us aprons to wear. I didn't love that there's a $3/person charge to use the sauce station. But overall, I thought it was pretty reasonably priced for Manhattan and the food quality + broth were delicious. We ordered the pork bone broth and mild spicy broth - the waiter warned us that mild is still decently spicy and i'm glad we listened. The waiters were speedy and attentive and refilled our broth regularly. And they gave us ice cream at the end!

Great time at this restaurant! It was our first time here. My niece and I were looking for a sit down spot from the cold and came across this and it was so welcoming. The staff very helpful and accommodating. Our server name was YY aka Molly! Shout out to her for such wonderful service. She made my niece birthday experience wonderful. The food was just what you need on cold new York day. Will visit again! Thank u!

A good hot pot spot conveniently located near Union Square. 

They put your purses and coats in plastic bins which was interesting, but probably smart as it keeps them from soaking up the smells of the restaurant. The menu was a bit overwhelming for us so we just picked one of their set menus, which was perfect, as it let us try a few different types of meat and we didn't have to worry about how many things to order. It was probably still too much food for the two of us, but it was a good proxy. The meat seemed to be good quality for the price and there were a lot of little sauces and sides to get from the bar in the back. We had a mushroom broth and a spicy broth, which was a  good contrast, and both flavorful in different ways.

At the end of the meal, they offer you free ice cream (it's just one of those little ice cream cups like you probably had as a kid).
great place - tomato broth is so tasty and i'll definitely come back! the food quality is also really good

This is a very cool spot to get Hot Pot. The tables are large and there's a lot of tables. The servers are super helpful, especially if you're not familiar with hot pot. The chicken and beef are both great options and I loved the mushroom broth.

Good food, great spot. Ordered three pots - tomato spicy and mushroom 

Free ice cream!!!!

Overall a good meal. 
Pork rib broth was rich and flavorful. We didn't feel like having spicy and it was nice to have this.
The food options were good but I did feel that should have been more options for fish balls like most other places...no regular fishballs, no cuttlefish balls, no fuzhou style meat stuffed fishballs. Only fish ball with roe, which were good. 
Veggie selection was solid, good choices available. 
Meat selection also solid, good variety to choose from in different price ranges.  
The only thing I will say that was extremely surprising and disappointing is that they charged close to $3pp for the sauce station. I have never been to a hotpot place that does this. Mixing the sauce is part of the experience and meal.

This was the neatest experience!!!  We had never had hot pot before. The staff here was so helpful and kind!  The broths were delicious and the selections were great!  We will definitely try this again!
very nice and great services the food is delicious and the bar rare is amazing very very nice and great services the food is delicious and the bar rare is amazing very nice
Pretty solid for a la carte hot pot. The service was pretty good and I really enjoyed their sauce bar.

Get the triple broth setup -- make sure one of them is the spicy chili. Personally, I think their thick-cut short ribs are excellent. And if you're not with your friends from Puxi, they'll help you with the sauce setup and the more exotic -- and tasty -- selections from the almost overwhelming menu.

The service? 10/10 the food !? 10/10 & the ambiance slayeeeeed 10/10 lol

The flavors were all so rich and exciting .. I have sm fun and got to try so many new foods .. the waiter/host was really kinda explaining what to do, how to cook it, etc as my friend and I are new to this food 

I really liked everything and ate all of those donuts before the meal was over lol

Very interesting, exciting atmosphere. I wish we were given a rundown of how things work here when we first are instead of being left to figure out with the iPad. There are all these things you can get with loyalty points (ingredients and even electronics), but we Couldn't get a sense of how to sign up or how any of it works. We didn't know there was a sauce station that is $2.99 per person and unlimited until after I used the bathroom, I came out and saw the station and asked about it.

For $19.99 you can get one, two or three kinds of broths. After ordering on the iPad, the ingredients came out extremely quickly, Followed by the broths. 

Our favorite was the pork rib broth Which had dates and goji. It was excellent and had a lot of flavor. The mushroom broth was good, saltier  and not as nuanced as pork rib. We also got the spicy broth (mild) And it was crazy hot. We asked if we were given a spicier version by accident, but the waitress said that was the mild. She was very nice and scooped out the peppers and added more broth to water it down for us.

The ingredients were fresh and good. And the sauces were good too. Liked that they offered grass jelly and fruits.

After tax and tip we spent a little more than $50 per person for a two person party. We were full. And they gave us Hershey ice cream after.

My friend and I ordered the mini hot pots, which come as individual servings of hot pot with a broth and mix of meat + veggies. These were very filling and I was satisfied. Next time I would opt for the large typical size for hotpot, sharing my feedback below. 

- Bc they are individual pots, they each come on its own small burner. We had some issues turning it back on once we turned them off.
- Since we each had our own burners, there is VERY limited space on the table when getting the mini pots and it was awkward to eat. Barely room for our plates + any additional food/drink we ordered AND the mini pot. If we used the main hot pot in the center of the table, we would not hve that issue. 
- The mini pots come with a preselected set of meat and veggies. Both pots my friend and I ordered included a LOT of tripe/stomach(?) meat that my friend and I did not eat (we don't typically eat this and frankly it looked unappetizing to us). If we went with the large pot, we would just not have ordered that type of meat.

A lot of the minor inconveniences I had with the experience attributed to the mini hot pots and not necessarily with the food quality or experience itself, so I'll leave it at 4 stars. I simply recommend going with the typical hot pot experience when dining here.

So huge and trendy and fun. Great staff. Quality ingredients.  The snack, dessert, sauce station awesome. Oyr mini hot pots are actually gigantic and worth it. My spicy broth was perfect. We also got bone broth. We added veggies. The fried pork delicious with powdered dip. The watermelon juice was fresh and scrumptious. Also the brown bobba rice cakes yummy. Get the housenade noodles .
Authentic Chinese hotpot. Good service and clean environment. Will visit again. 10/10 recommendation
Great food, great people.  Very fresh and good for loud kids.   It's very spicy so Anglo saxons should beware.

Our experience at this place was satisfying! Workers exhibit exceptional kindness and happily offer guidance if you look undecided. The place combines spotless conditions with good illumination. The ingredients taste fresh and good. The entire visit was enjoyable.

Shoo Loong Kan's Flushing location is a go-to, so I had to check out their Manhattan spot! The tomato and pork bone broths were rich and comforting, and the A5 Wagyu was a standout (tender and buttery).

With a fully stocked sauce station, wide selection of ingredients, attentive service, and solid portions, it's a hot pot experience worth trying.
I like this location better than Flushing. The restaurant is well ventilated and doesn't have strong hotpot smell. Food was delicious. Service was very good. Happy with everything

The 3 types of broth is the perfect choice if you have a big party and I really liked the mushroom broth, pork rib broth, and house special chili broth. They all soaked in flavor to the raw meats, seafood, and veggies!

Definitely give them a follow on Instagram so you can get a free drink (while promo/supplies last) and try some of their yummy hot appetizers. Service was quick and excellent and the space is so nice and big! They also have a good selection of sauces to create your own dipping sauce, snacks, and dessert to choose from.
Food is amazing and servers was very enthusiastic. Their broth are really spicy. if you not good at spicy try mild spicy that is enough.

I was wrong, wagyu DOES belong at the hot pot table. Wow, it was so good and tender and flavorful and rich. This is an a-la-carte place but the ingredients and offerings feel very elevated and worth it to try for the price. Portion sizes are decently large (in a good way). 

The house special chili broth is quite spicy, even at mild. I preferred the pork rib broth, which was very flavorful and not too heavy, and it paired with everything. The handmade noodles were nicely chewy and one order is good for two people in my opinion. I also recommend the house special tripe, which also has a nice texture and consistency, and is wider and larger than the standard tripe they have. Fish roe ball was also one of our favorites - the filling is super flavorful and has lots of roe. 

I definitely recommend trying the milk mochi, such a huge portion and the perfect dessert. Brown sugar rice cake was also yummy, crispy outside with a nice chewy inside.

Service is very attentive. They provide aprons for you and also help you pack up any leftovers (I haven't been to a hot pot place yet that let's you take home leftovers). Everything in the restaurant also felt very clean, from the sauce bar to the restrooms. Overall, Shoo Loong Kan has now made it's way onto my radar as an elevated and luxurious hot pot spot, and the crowds are there to prove it.

A pretty decent hot pot spot in the city! Located near Union Square, this hotpot spot offers great Chinese hot pot. Service here is pretty good and we were fortunately able to grab a table on a Saturday for a dinner without a wait. 

We got a variety of meats and veggies and everything was pretty good! Their spicy broth was SUPER spicy though, so be warned. Their sauce bar was also pretty solid, clean, and well-stocked. Would come back for hot pot if I'm in the area.

If you ever step foot into an Asian Supermarket and go to the hot pot section for some DIY hot pot, there's a few brand names that's available for purchase: Haidilao, Happy Lamb, and then there's Shoo Loong Kan. They all have their own restaurants as well. Unfortunately, Haidilao and Happy Lamb are both in Flushing, which is a super far trek not worth going out of the way just for hot pot. Luckily Shoo Loong Kan decided to open their location in Manhattan in the heart of Union Square, making this a convenient location for me and my Manhattan folks.

I came here with my fiancee during the winter when I learned this location existed. Reservations is highly recommended, otherwise there's a waitlist available. They have trash bags available to put your jacket or any other stuff you don't want to get stinky from the hot pot. Their sauce station is a bit overwhelming with various selections. Food is ordered via iPad and they have a huge selection, including high quality meat and seafood. There's a nice veggie selection as well. Overall it's a great hot pot option that's pretty reasonable in price.

I think this location in Manhattan opened relatively recently :0 There's usually a pretty long queue at the branch in Flushing, so I was relieved when my friend and I were quoted  ~5-10 minute wait time when we got there around 6:30 on a weekday.

For the soup base broth you can choose a pot with 1/2/3 "options" (e.g. different broths), and it was very funny to us that the 1-broth pot costs more than the 2-broth option but less than the 3-broth one?? maybe someone can explain what the pricing logic is here haha

We opted for the two-broth pot with pork rib and tomato, and they were both sooo good! Honestly the pork rib broth was one of the highlights of the meal; it was so fragrant and not too salty that we drank a lot of it at the end of our meal. Delicious

Despite being one of the cheaper options, the "premium beef slices" (精品肥牛) were our favourite meat option. Other than that, we loved the sweet potato noodles (ended up getting a few orders of this after scarfing them down super quickly). Veggies were fresh and tasty across the board.

I also really liked the ice cream at the end of the meal hehe, and the sauce bar w some sweet desserts was also a nice touch to round everything out. Even though we were both quite full, dessert goes into a separate stomach so we still enjoyed some jelly on top of the ice cream.

Overall price point was solid! Definitely not cheap, but I think the quality and quantity of the food make the cost worthwhile, and I think had we come with even more people it would have been even more reasonable (IMO hot pot gets much more efficient with larger groups of people).

I'd definitely come again (if just for the delicious pork broth!)

@shooloongkanmanhattan is an authentic chinese hotpot place! There are so many hotpot ingredients to choose from. I really appreciated how attentive the waiters/waitresses were to us!

ft:
-Pork broth/less spicy hot chilli broth: Pork broth was pretty standard. It had a large bone of pork in the broth to add flavor. THE SPICY BROTH IS SPICY. I do not have a spice tolerance at all, but my friends that do like spice said the less spicy was spicy  
-Premium beef slices: Very awesome! good quality and very easy to chew.
-Wagyu shoulder: You could see the nice marbling on the meat, and it was rather tender. I love wagyu
-Diced wagyu: I think I liked the shoulder better just because there was more meat in one bite. Still very tasty!
-Quail Eggs: I LOVE QUAIL EGGS. THESE WERE GOOD.
-Vegetable Platter: It came with enoki mushroom, spinach, and other assortment of greens. Very enjoyable and is refreshing to eat while eating a lot of meat!
-Fish Roe Ball: GET THESE. I love fish roe balls in hotpot so much. Super flavorful.
-Scallops: The plating was so beautiful!!! I really like scallops as well, and these were great!

I really liked how this hotpot place had nice plating. A lot of restaurants often skip out on the plating since you put all the ingredients to cook it anyways. But it was very aesthetic and I loved it!
Amazing food and service! Loved this place. I had shrimp dumplings and soup and they were incredible.

I was totally impressed by the luxurious line-up of premium meats and seafood. From A5 wagyu to miyazaki wagyu, and abalone to scallops, all the ingredients are fresh and top graded. 

While there are so many hot pot spots in NYC, I found Shoo Loong Kan is not like the other chains. The restaurant is exceptionally clean, bright and modern. Their service is 100% attentive and caring. There is a storage space under your chair to keep the hot pot smell out of your belongings and coats (so thankful for this design). Aprons are also provided. 

Conveniently located only 5 minutes away from Union Square, Shoo Loong Kan brings authentic Szechuan flavors to the city. 

Our favorites:  
＊A5 Wagyu Beef Shoulder A5和牛嫩肩**
The A5 wagyu beef has beautiful marbling and was decently cut into thin slices. It literally melted in my mouth with a burst of rich buttery flavor. 

＊Handmade Beef Ball 手工牛肉丸***
Their beef balls were surprisingly my favorite. Unlike the typical store bought ones, they tasted fresh, bouncy and meaty. 

＊Fresh Scallops 冰鮮貝柱**
Scallops were fresh with a hint of lemon-y flavor. It was super smooth and tender after cooked. 

＊Shrimp Paste 手打蝦滑*
Their housemade shrimp paste with fish roe was a fantastic addition to the hot pot. An elevated version of premade smashed shrimp balls. 

＊Chinese Black Sesame Donut w. Mochi***
These Chinese donuts are basically deep fried donuts filled with mochi and sprinkled with black sesame. Be sure to enjoy them when they are still warm--the fried dough is soft while the mochi is stretchy. 10/10 dessert!!

Broth:
＊House Special Chili Broth 招牌紅鍋
SUPER SPICY. Don't order unless you're very confident of your spice tolerance...

＊Tomato Broth 蕃茄鍋*
Very rich and thick tomato soup. Actual tomatoes were added to the broth. 

＊Pork Rib Broth 排骨鍋*
Highly recommend this broth for non-spice eaters. It is so flavorful and matches any ingredients. We even found a giant piece of pork rib in our soup!

The hot pot here is incredible--everything is incredibly fresh, from the crisp vegetables to the tender meats and seafood. It reminds me of the authentic hot pot I had during my travels in China, with a rich, flavorful broth that perfectly balances spice and depth. An amazing, authentic experience that's hard to beat! Amazing service, free snacks and free ice cream... must visit!

I like this hotpot place as I have been to a different location so this review is for the service. I called ahead to check if there was a wait time on a rainy day for a party of 2. I called just 30 minutes ahead of when I was arriving and the lady who picked up said it shouldn't be a problem. I get there and there is a freaking wait of other TEN other groups of people. This is so misleading and leaves a bad taste in my mouth from the lack of transparency. If she was just honest we would NOT have trekked all the way here in the rain because we are NOT looking to wait over an hour in the rain for a table. I don't know if she was lying to drive business or what but this is so frustrating. We tried waiting for over FORTY minutes with NO movement and just gave up. And I tried to ask how long of a wait it was and she kept telling me 3 tables were finishing up and it should be around 20 minutes but FORTY minutes later we are not even close. She should have just told us to leave and come back another time at that point. Her name started with an A and I hate her guts. BE HONEST. It's not hard.

Update: our table was called 1 hour and 10 minutes later after A lied and said it would be about 20 minutes. Luckily we knew she was lying and were already done with our appetizers at another restaurant nearby by that time!

My favorite hotpot restaurant is open in Manhattan now!! I regularly traveled from the city to the flushing location, so I'm glad there is one closer now. I wish their hours were longer like the flushing location

Will definitely be back!

The food was very good and the service was impeccable. Don't be shy get it spicy and have fun! They gave us free ice cream at the end and also a soju cocktail during our meal. The wagyu was perfect too. Will surely go here again!

A bit pricey but a solid hotpot place. The environment was clean and  staff were attentive and continuously refilling the soup base. Even if you can tolerate mala spice, I caution you from messing with the spice level because it is real. Best bet is to start with no spice or mild. Portion size of the beef is on the smaller end and food is overall a bit pricey. But overall not bad if you are looking for a solid hotpot place.
